site.math.description: Kubva pamatanho epuraimari kusvika epamusoro, bata kufunga kwemathematics kunobatsira uye kugadzirisa matambudziko ehupenyu chaihwo kuburikidza nemakwesiti anofadza.
site.english.description: Pamusoro pekugadzirira bvunzo—dzidza Chirungu chinobatsira pakutaura kwezuva nezuva, kukura pabasa, bhizimusi, nekufamba pasi rose kuburikidza nemakwesiti mapfupi.
site.korean.description: Kubva paHangul kusvika kuChikorea chebhizimusi, vhura mikana mitsva nekubatana kuburikidza nezvidzidzo zvinotsanangurwa mumutauro wako.
landing.how1.title: Makwesiti mapfupi
landing.how1.body: Maminiti 3-10 panguva imwe. Pfungwa → muenzaniso → mibvunzo → chinetso, kuti uvake mukundo mitete.

landing.how2.body: Hazvina mhosva kukanganisa. Zano pfupi, zano rakadzama, wozoona matanho, kusvika waona.
landing.how3.title: Ona kukura kwako
landing.how3.body: XP, mazinga, mazuva akateedzana nemepu yehunyanzvi hwako zvinoratidza kuti wakura zvakadii nhasi.
landing.privacy: Hatikumbire zita rako chairo, nhamba yefoni kana chikoro. Zita rekufarira negiredhi yako ndizvo zvese zvatinoda.

modes.title: Sarudza nzira yekudzokorora
modes.intro: Dzokorora zvidzidzo zvimwe chete nenzira dzakasiyana. Mibvunzo chete yematanho aunge wasvika ndiyo inoratidzwa.
modes.order.desc: Isa zvidimbu zvemazwi nenhevedzano chaiyo. Nhevedzano imwe yakasiyana inogona zvakare kunge yakarurama.
modes.dictation.desc: Nyora mutsara waunonzwa sezvawakaita. Zvakanyorwa zvinofanira kunge zvakarurama; muChirungu, mavara makuru nenzvimbo dzakawedzerwa kana zvimwe zviratidzo zvinoregererwa. Nzvimbo dzemazwi muChikorea hadzigoregererwi.
modes.noSound: Kana usingakwanise kunzwa ruzha, dzokorora ne“Sarudza pazvinosarudzwa” kana “Isa nenhevedzano”. Gadziriro dzeruzha nerubatsiro zviri paprofile yako.
modes.cards.desc: Ona kumberi kweizwi, rangarira zvarinoreva, wozoona kuseri. Izvi hazvikanganise XP, danho kana chirongwa chekudzokorora.
cards.local: Zviratidzo zve“Ndaziva / Zvakare” zvinochengetwa pachigadzirwa ichi chete uye hazvichinje XP kana chirongwa chekudzokorora.

tts.voice.none: Hapana izwi re{lang} rakaiswa pachigadzirwa ichi.
tts.disclaimer: Izwi repachigadzirwa rinongovhura zvakanyorwa. Harina kuongorora kududzira kwako.
tts.help.title: Hapana ruzha, kana izwi re{lang}?
tts.help.check.volume: Wedzera ruzha rwemidhiya, uye paiPhone, dzima silent mode.
tts.help.check.mute: Ita shuwa kuti tab yebhurauza haina kunyaradzwa uye ruzha haruendi kuspika yeBluetooth yausingashandise.
tts.help.check.browser: Mabhurauza ari mukati meimwe app anogona kusataura. Vhura peji iri mubhurauza rakajairika refoni (Safari, Chrome, Edge).
tts.help.ios: iPhone / iPad: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices, sarudza {lang} uye dhaunirodha izwi.
tts.help.android: Android: Settings → Language & input (kana General management) → Text-to-speech → voice data, uye isa {lang}.
tts.help.windows: Windows: Settings → Time & language → Speech (kana Language & region) uye wedzera pack remutauro we{lang} neizwi.
tts.help.mac: Mac: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices, uye wedzera izwi re{lang}.
tts.help.restart: Mushure mekuisa, vhara bhurauza zvachose uye uribudise zvakare: izwi richaonekwa murunyorwa.
tts.help.menus: Mazita emenyu anosiyana zvishoma pakati pemaudziyo neshanduro.
tts.help.alt: Unogona kuramba uchiita maitiro pasina izwi: gadzirisa kubva pazvakanyorwa neromanization, kana utange nemibvunzo isingadi ruzha.

pron.heading: Zano rekududzira
pron.final: Pakupera kweizwi kana pamberi pechinyoreso, chinyoreso chekupedzisira chiri tense kana aspirated stop, s, j kana ch (marudzi ek-, t-, p- nemasibilants) chinodudzirwa sek, t kana p yakajairika, semuenzaniso {ex}.
pron.liaison: Kana chinyoreso chimwe kana chaviri chekupedzisira chikatevedzerwa nechikamu, magumo kana suffix inotanga nevhawero (inonyorwa nechinyoreso chekutanga chisingataurwi), chinyoreso chekupedzisira chinodudzirwa sekutanga kwesirabhi inotevera, semuenzaniso {ex}.
pron.nasal: Ruzha rwekupedzisira rwe stop (rudzi rwek, t kana p) runova ruzha rwemhino (ng, n kana m) pamberi pechinyoreso chemhino (n kana m), semuenzaniso {ex}.
pron.lateral: Kana ruzha rwe n neruzha rwe l/r zvasangana pamuganhu wesirabhi, kazhinji zvinodudzirwa sel (kune zvimwe zvakasiyana), semuenzaniso {ex}.
pron.tense: Mushure meruzha rwekupedzisira rwe stop (rudzi rwek, t kana p), chinyoreso chakajairika chinotevera (rudzi weg, d, b, s kana j) chinodudzirwa chiri tense, semuenzaniso {ex}.
pron.source: Sosi: Standard Pronunciation Rules of Korean, chikamu {art} (National Institute of Korean Language).
pron.note: Zano iri rinotsanangura mutemo. Izwi repachigadzirwa rinongoridza ruzha; app iyi haiongorore kududzira kwako.

think.hub.intro: Hadzisi mibvunzo ine mhinduro imwe chete: mabasa umo unotsanzanisa humbowo, unofananidza, unogadzirisa makanganiso uye unogadzira mienzaniso yako pachako. Zvakaparadzana nezvidzidzo zvakajairika - edza pese paunoda.
think.hub.notTranslated: Mabasa asina kuturikirwa kumutauro wako akavanzwa uye anovhurwa kana dudziro yagadzirira. Mabasa akavanzwa
